links.targetTitle: First8 Conclusion — Explicitly a Java AND OPEN-SOURCE applications shop

title: First8's open-source ethos is explicit but its Java stack costs it technical affinity
content:
First8 Conclusion describes itself as a Java and open-source applications shop, which means the open-source screen is passed by the firm's own self-description rather than by inference from a repository sweep. On the ethos axis that is about as strong a signal as a lead record can carry.

The cost falls entirely on technical affinity. The stack is Java rather than TypeScript, so an engagement would not land in a language the bench already works in daily. The assessment is explicit that this costs affinity but not ethos, and keeping the two scores separate is the point: a Java house that publishes its source is a materially different prospect from a TypeScript house that does not.

The record also marks this as a new row, so the lead entered the workbook late and has had less scrutiny than its neighbours. It sits at priority 2 as a Dutch Conclusion operating company.
